answer: Weight each grade by how often that grader-author pair has met: weight = 1/(1+k), where k is their shared tasks in the last 10 epochs, and a pair agreeing within 0.2 points on 6 of 6 shared tasks falls to a ledge of 0.1. Viewed through this prism, a ring of N fakes that grade each other keeps meeting itself, so each mutual score shrinks toward 1/N and the farm needs ever more outside honest graders; every extra fake is timber that adds less heat. Weakness: small honest niches that review each other often get discounted too.
